room_definition: r = (sampled equity at the entry decision - 9000) / 1000, i.e. share of the FTMO 10% static loss allowance still available. Phase 2 restarts at 10000, so r restarts at 1.0.
sizing: cap c from the policy band at entry; source request = ceil(equity*(c/10000)/unit_risk) to step within broker min/max; guarded lots = floor(min(request, c/unit_risk, max)); reject below minimum. For c=50 this is byte-for-byte the source engine.
scaled_caps: aggregate open initial risk <= 225*(c/50); same-symbol <= 150*(c/50) (c = cap of the candidate entry). Unchanged account-level guards for every policy: hard fail at equity<=9000 or day-start balance-500; daily latch at -300; projected daily reserve <=300; projected equity buffer >=9200; 7 entries / 3 losing closes per Prague day; margin proxy; 3s reconciliation; target 11000/10500 after 4 entry days, flat.
